name: Rating / Customer Satisfaction
description: Customer Satisfaction product scenario for the Rating component.

controls.name: value
controls.description: Controlled finite score, bounded to 0..max. Zero means unrated.

controls.name: defaultValue
controls.description: Initial uncontrolled score, restored by form reset. Defaults to 0.

controls.name: max
controls.description: Number of stars: an integer from 1 to 10. Defaults to 5.

controls.name: disabled
controls.description: Disable editing and native form submission, retaining the displayed score.

controls.name: readOnly
controls.description: Display a precise average as a measurement, without editing or required validation.

controls.name: allowHalf
controls.description: Allow half-star input steps. Readonly averages always retain exact fractions.

controls.name: label
controls.description: Noninteractive visible name; empty content falls back to native naming attributes.

controls.name: aria-label
controls.description: Name override, or a name when no visible label is provided.

controls.name: aria-labelledby
controls.description: External naming elements; takes precedence over label and aria-label.

controls.name: form
controls.description: Id of an external native form that owns this score.

controls.name: autoFocus
controls.description: Focus the selected or first editable choice on mount. Defaults to false.

controls.name: membrane
controls.description: Shared membrane spacing around each choice and the label. Defaults to true.

controls.name: name
controls.description: Nonempty native form key; use a distinct name for each independent rating.

controls.name: required
controls.description: Require a score before submitting an editable rating. Defaults to false.
